category: Define Security Requirements for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Communicate the security requirements to all relevant parties, including but not limited to development teams, operations teams, and third-party suppliers.
implementation_examples: Publish security requirements in a developer handbook accessible to all engineers
Communicate security requirements via onboarding training for new developers and contractors
Send explicit security-requirement briefings to third-party developers and suppliers
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security requirements are disseminated to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
Determine whether acknowledgement of security requirements is recorded for each stakeholder.
